message: The value of the constant 'WANTED' is not a constant expression: it is a member of a built-in enum, and enum values are not constants in v0.1.
notes: a constant may use only literals, other constants, operators, conversions, constructors and const-eligible built-in functions

message: The filter of `on key_down` must be a constant Key member, written like `Key.Space`.
notes: a filter is fixed when the program is built, so it cannot be a state, a local or any other value that changes at run time
help: to react to a key that is only known at run time, test `is_key_down(...)` inside `update`, or handle each key in a handler of its own: `on key_down(Key.Space) { ... }`
